xBRIEFInfo.description: Plan for PAN-4655: Auto-settle idle conversations after a configurable number of days

plan.title: Auto-settle idle conversations after a configurable number of days
plan.author: agent:claude-opus-5-5

metadata.sizeJustification: About 24 files. The subsystem count (first two path segments) is inflated by single files that every complete feature touches: the init migration (drizzle/overdeck), the skill text (sync-sources/skills), two docs pages, the frontend test subset list and the no-loss matrix (tests/unit). Splitting the Settings control or the CLI verb into a sibling issue would not lower that count, and the issue requires the setting surfaces together with the sweep. The core (column, sweep, patrol) cannot ship in parts.

narratives.Problem: PAN-4639 added Settle and Snooze to the conversation list, but every conversation stays in Inbox until the operator settles it by hand. Conversations nobody has touched for days pile up in Inbox. The issue asks the primary dashboard to settle an operator conversation automatically after a configurable number of idle days (default 3, 0 = off), without ever settling agent conversations, snoozed ones, or ones waiting on the operator, and without re-settling a conversation the operator just brought back.
narratives.Proposal: Add an app_settings key conversations.auto_settle_idle_days (door in control-settings.ts, default 3) with a GET/PUT route, a Settings → Conversations number input and a pan conversations auto-settle-idle-days verb. Add a nullable idle_reset_at column that unsettle and unsnooze set to now, plus a guarded settleIdleConversation store write. A pure sweep (src/lib/overdeck/conversation-idle-settle.ts) groups operator conversations by the Command Deck display-parent rule, filters roots by cheap DB checks, skips the pass when liveness or the pending-input feed is unknown, reads last activity with one stat (and a transcript tail read only when the mtime is recent, because Claude touches live transcripts hourly), and settles idle roots with reason idle. A dashboard patrol runs it 2 minutes after boot and every 15 minutes, only on the primary dashboard and never while the Deacon is frozen. main.ts is at 997/1000 lines, so the existing conversation sweep starts move into services/conversation-sweeps.ts first and the patrol registers there. Docs in features/conversations.mdx, docs/DASHBOARD-ARCHITECTURE.md and the pan-conversations skill; a supersession comment on #1485.
narratives.NonGoals:
- No change to auto-archive on merge, conversations.auto_archive_on_merge, pan conv auto-archive-on-merge, or anything PAN-4653 owns.
- No archiving, stopping, resuming or messaging of any conversation; idle-settle writes only settled_at, settle_reason and snoozed_until.
- No warning stage before settling and no settle-reason label in the conversation list.
- Favorited conversations are not exempt from idle-settle.
- A message queued for a usage-limit reset (conversation_scheduled_messages) does not block idle-settle.
- Linked conversations from other machines and vault browse copies are never touched.
- Child rows of a group are never idle-settled, and new activity never unsettles a row (PAN-4639 D8).
- No activity-feed entry or notification for idle-settles; a log line only.
- #1485 is commented on, not closed.

autoDecisions.summary: Activity = max(createdAt, lastAttachedAt, transcript activity); viewing without resuming does not count.
autoDecisions.rationale: Operator messages are written to the transcript as user records; lastAttachedAt is written only by an operator resume/reattach (conversation-runtime.ts:1092), so counting it is the conservative reading of 'no operator message'.

autoDecisions.summary: Transcript activity is the file mtime when it is older than the cutoff, else the last user/assistant record time from scanPendingInputs, else the mtime.
autoDecisions.rationale: A record cannot be newer than the file's mtime, so an old mtime proves idleness with one stat; a recent mtime may be Claude's hourly touch (PAN-4515), so only then is the 512 KB tail read.

autoDecisions.summary: New nullable column idle_reset_at, set by unsettle and unsnooze; a snooze that ends by time uses the past snoozed_until value as its restart point.
autoDecisions.rationale: Unsettle clears settled_at and leaves no trace, so without a stored time the next sweep would re-settle the conversation the operator just brought back, which the issue forbids.

autoDecisions.summary: Only group roots are idle-settled, and a group is idle only when every member is idle.
autoDecisions.rationale: PAN-4639 decides a group's section from its root (sectionOf); settling a root whose lane or successor is busy would hide active work in Settled.

autoDecisions.summary: 'Waiting on the operator' uses the pending-input feed (getConversationsPendingInputFeed), a superset of pendingInputCount.
autoDecisions.rationale: The feed also sees terminal permission prompts, pane choice menus and held kickoffs; broader is safer, and it is the server source of Needs-you.

autoDecisions.summary: Unknown liveness or a failed pending-input feed skips the whole sweep; a failed setting read reads as 0 (off).
autoDecisions.rationale: Same rule as autoArchiveSettledConversations: never act on unknown state.

autoDecisions.summary: Released conversations (released_to set) and rows with a fork in progress are skipped.
autoDecisions.rationale: A released row is read-only on this machine (conversation-release.ts); a pending fork is still being created.

autoDecisions.summary: Patrol cadence: first sweep 2 minutes after boot, then every 15 minutes; skipped on peers, while the Deacon is frozen, with OVERDECK_DISABLE_IDLE_SETTLE=1, and while a sweep is in flight.
autoDecisions.rationale: Day-granular thresholds need no faster cadence; the skips mirror scheduled-message-patrol.ts, and the Deacon freeze is the operator's emergency stop for automation.

autoDecisions.summary: Extract the PR-sync and schedule starts/stops from main.ts into services/conversation-sweeps.ts before registering the new patrol there.
autoDecisions.rationale: main.ts is 997 lines against the 1000-line file-size ceiling and is not allowlisted; agents may not raise allowlist rows.
A two-segment path cannot be matched as a conversation id, it groups with the triage route, and the object leaves room for PAN-4653's onMerge field.

autoDecisions.summary: CLI verb pan conversations auto-settle-idle-days [days] writes app_settings directly.
autoDecisions.rationale: Same shape and mechanism as auto-archive-on-merge; works with the dashboard down because the sweep reads the value each pass.

autoDecisions.summary: Default 3 days is on after upgrade; the first sweep settles every conversation already idle that long.
autoDecisions.rationale: The issue sets the default; settling is display-only and undoable, so the issue drops #1485's warning stage.

autoDecisions.summary: Comment on #1485 that its archive-after-idle part is superseded; do not close it.
autoDecisions.rationale: Archive at day 10 and clearing favorites are not delivered here; closing is the operator's call. The issue allows 'update or close'.

autoDecisions.summary: Keep one xBRIEF with plan.metadata.sizeJustification instead of sibling issues.
autoDecisions.rationale: The subsystem count is driven by single docs/migration/list files that a split would not remove; the issue requires the setting surfaces with the sweep.

Add `IdleClock` { settledAtMs, snoozedUntilMs, idleResetAtMs }, `listIdleClocks(): Map<string, IdleClock>` (one SELECT over unarchived rows), and `settleIdleConversation(name, cutoffMs, nowMs)` whose single UPDATE sets settled_at = nowMs, settle_reason = 'idle', snoozed_until = NULL WHERE name = ? AND archived_at IS NULL AND settled_at IS NULL AND (snoozed_until IS NULL OR snoozed_until <= cutoffMs) AND (idle_reset_at IS NULL OR idle_reset_at <= cutoffMs), returning changes > 0. narrative.Action: PRD WI-6. New src/dashboard/server/services/conversation-idle-settle-service.ts on the scheduled-message-patrol.ts pattern: IDLE_SETTLE_BOOT_DELAY_MS = 120_000, IDLE_SETTLE_INTERVAL_MS = 900_000, IdleSettlePatrolDeps { sweep?, isFrozen?, invalidate?, log? }, startConversationIdleSettleService(deps?) returning false for OVERDECK_DISABLE_IDLE_SETTLE=1, isPeerDashboardProcess(), or an existing start; otherwise a boot timeout then an interval, both unref'd. Each run: silent skip when isDeaconGloballyPaused(); skip with '[idle-settle] previous sweep still running, skipping' while one is in flight; non-empty result → invalidate() (default invalidateConversationListEnrichmentCache) and log '[idle-settle] settled N idle conversation(s): a, b'; throw → console.warn('[idle-settle] sweep failed:', error). The default sweep calls sweepIdleConversations with listLiveSessions = listLiveConversationSessions, listWaitingNames = getConversationsPendingInputFeed({ resolveSessionFile, listSessionNames: async () => [...live] }) mapped to a Set of row names (null when status is set or the body is not an array), resolveTranscript = resolveSessionFile. stopConversationIdleSettleService() clears both timers. In conversation-sweeps.ts, startConversationSweeps() also logs '[idle-settle] started (boot +2m, 15m sweep)' when the start returns true, and stopConversationSweeps() stops it. Tests use vi.useFakeTimers() and advanceTimersByTimeAsync with mocked boot-gates.js and control-settings.js.
